import re
from pathlib import Path
import tarfile

# Constants
PATTERN = r"(?<!Distillr)\\\\AcroTray\.exe"
DIRECTORY = r"C:\\SomeDir\\"

def task_func(directory=DIRECTORY, file_pattern=PATTERN):
    root = Path(directory)
    regex = re.compile(file_pattern)

    def _candidate_texts(path: Path):
        raw = str(path)
        yield raw
        yield raw.replace("\\", "\\\\")
        yield raw.replace("/", "\\\\")

    matched_files = []
    if root.exists():
        for path in root.rglob("*"):
            if path.is_file() and any(regex.search(text) for text in _candidate_texts(path)):
                matched_files.append(path)

    tar_path = root / "AcroTray_matches.tar"
    tar_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with tarfile.open(tar_path, "w") as tar:
        for path in matched_files:
            tar.add(path, arcname=path.relative_to(root))

    return str(tar_path)
